push.title: W 5-0 vs liveislikeadih | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #5)
push.body:
Ten. Point. Zero. BellyTb1, that's a Perfect Game #5 and I'd like it laminated, please.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 5th Perfect Game for us. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 7.7. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ 6 shots at liveislikeadih's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ 1 key pass. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ Man of the Match, your 13th for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.

THE BAD
- Won 1 of 4 tackles (down from your usual 65%). Focus point: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged. Steady does it.
- You and PhogsToffees have a shared to-do on tackle timing: one presses, one covers.
- Pass accuracy: 88%. Aim for 88%+.
- Shots on target: 67%. Steady. Elite forwards get to 90%+.

Tonight's homework: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

Thanks for making it look easy. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 5-0 vs liveislikeadih | You: 9.5 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Well I'll be. PhogsToffees, a 9.5. You played like the main character tonight.

THE GOOD
+ 90% passing on 29 attempts, up from your usual 79%. Precision like that wins tight games.
+ 11 shots at liveislikeadih's goal. You were knocking on that door like you were selling encyclopedias.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 2). You see the field like a hawk sees a cornfield.
+ You and BellyTb1 were finishing each other's sentences out there.
+ Your 2nd best match performance of the season: 9.5. That's the standard now.

THE BAD
- 2 of 11 shots on target. Easy money: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- Won 1 of 4 tackles (down from your usual 41%). Habit to build: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike. Biscuits if you nail it.
- tackle timing is your shared homework with BellyTb1: one presses, one covers.
- Passes attempted 29, from 33 in your previous match. That's the kind of number that loses matches.

Repetition station: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: Believe in yourself the way your dog believes in you.

Champions are made on nights like this. - Coach Lasso
